metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in urban areas of Atlanta, Georgia increase in December 2013 compared to July 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS Nighttime Lights data (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG) - Compare July 2013 vs December 2013 - Focus on urban areas of Atlanta, Georgia - Location: Atlanta center approximately (-84.388, 33.749) 2. Masking strategy: - VIIRS nighttime lights already filters out clouds and transient lights - Use 'avg_rad' band for average radiance - No additional masking needed for this comparison 3. Logic: - Calculate mean nighttime light intensity for urban Atlanta in July 2013 - Calculate mean nighttime light intensity for urban Atlanta in December 2013 - Compare December vs July values - Valid Zero: If urban areas have zero light (unlikely but possible = B) - C1: If no images exist for either month - C2: If no valid pixels after processing - C3: If results are None/NaN - A: If December > July (increase) - B: If December <= July (no increase) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Atlanta urban area const atlanta = ee.Geometry.Point([-84.388, 33.749]).buffer(15000); // 15km radius for urban area // Define time periods const july2013Start = '2013-07-01'; const july2013End = '2013-07-31'; const dec2013Start = '2013-12-01'; const dec2013End = '2013-12-31'; // Load VIIRS Nighttime Lights monthly data const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG'); // Get July 2013 data const july2013 = viirs .filterDate(july2013Start, july2013End) .filterBounds(atlanta); const julySize = july2013.size().getInfo(); console.log('July 2013 images:', julySize); if (julySize === 0) { console.log('No data for July 2013.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get December 2013 data const dec2013 = viirs .filterDate(dec2013Start, dec2013End) .filterBounds(atlanta); const decSize = dec2013.size().getInfo(); console.log('December 2013 images:', decSize); if (decSize === 0) { console.log('No data for December 2013.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get mean images for each period const julyImage = july2013.select('avg_rad').mean(); const decImage = dec2013.select('avg_rad').mean(); // Check pixel counts const julyCount = julyImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: atlanta, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log('July valid pixels:', julyCount); if (julyCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for July 2013.'); console.log('C2'); return; } const decCount = decImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: atlanta, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log('December valid pixels:', decCount); if (decCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for December 2013.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate mean nighttime light intensity const julyMean = julyImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: atlanta, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const decMean = decImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: atlanta, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log('July 2013 mean light intensity:', julyMean); console.log('December 2013 mean light intensity:', decMean); // Validate results if (julyMean === null || decMean === null || isNaN(julyMean) || isNaN(decMean) || julyMean < 0 || decMean < 0) { console.log('Invalid calculation results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare December vs July const increase = decMean - julyMean; console.log('Change (Dec - July):', increase.toFixed(4)); if (decMean > julyMean) { console.log('December nighttime lights increased compared to July.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('December nighttime lights did not increase compared to July.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
